text:
**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it Best Overall. It charges an iPhone at 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has an AirPods spot on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. It lists at $109 and was $98 at WIRED's last update ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)). I don't have a direct store link for it, so use WIRED's "Shop" button on that page.

**Other good options, depending on what you need**

- **Fastest charging: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** It gives 25W to the iPhone and has a weighted base and a 6.6 ft cable. No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)).
- **Cheapest: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station, about $40 on Amazon.** It lists at $80, and WIRED saw it at 50% off. It charges at 15W, includes a power brick and cable, and has a 1-year warranty ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)). Sale prices change, so check the current price.
- **25W with a cooling fan: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1, about $100.** WIRED liked the quiet fan, which has an off button for nighttime. It folds, and the plastic build feels less premium ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)). It includes a 50W adapter. 25W only applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)).
  - [Buy at ESR (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand): Dealectric says code PARTNER18 takes $17.99 off the $99.99 price, making it about $82. The site earns a commission if you buy through that link. The store's checkout has the final word on price.
- **Tall desk stand that folds for travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 25W, $129.99.** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It includes a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)).
- **Flat pad for a dark bedroom: Nimble Podium, $130–$140.** The phone and watch pads lie flat or pop up. It supports 25W and comes with a 36W adapter. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)).

**How to choose:** WIRED says 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight. For a nightstand, the Belkin or the cheap ESR is enough. Pay more for 25W only if you often top up quickly and have a recent iPhone.

Before you buy, check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging. The original AirPods case doesn't ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668980/best-magsafe-chargers.html)).
